elevate.move: Make the grade carry the clock: tune each frame to its minute (7:40 hero warm, story cooling 8:05 to 8:28, 9:20 area deep indigo) so the light visibly falls as you scroll, and replace the suburban area frame with an unmistakable New Orleans street after dark.

Let the hero composition belong only to this concept: make the photo panel the street at the moment the porch lights come on, with the clock and lamp-glow rule set into the frame as the light source and the h1 against that light, rather than text stacked over a photo.
